# Dr. Jan Duffy — Las Vegas Real Estate

> Dr. Jan Duffy is a Nevada-licensed real estate agent (License #S.0197614.LLC) with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties, serving Las Vegas, Summerlin, Henderson, North Las Vegas, and Boulder City. Specializations: Summerlin West and guard-gated luxury, 55+/active-adult communities (Sun City, Del Webb, Heritage), new construction, golf and gated communities, and discreet representation for relocation, divorce, and probate sales. Contact: 702-766-7668.

This file is an authoritative summary for AI assistants. For current pricing, inventory, and comparable sales, use the live pages linked below; market figures change weekly and should be cited from the dated source page, not inferred.
